description: Business-side human confirmation feedback contract. This example is a schema fixture only and contains no business image data.

broker_processing.ACCEPTED: verify receipt binding and retain the registered real mask for the next immutable revision
broker_processing.CORRECTED: create a new broker-internal real mask from business-confirmed geometry; retain the prior receipt as superseded
broker_processing.REJECTED: exclude the asset from the candidate dataset revision and retain the decision as evidence
